mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `system_store_franchisee_info` (`store_id`, `franchisee_name`, `franchisee_mobile`, `id_card_no`, `bank_name`, `bank_province`, `bank_city`, `bank_card_no`, `creator`, `create_time`, `updater`, `update_time`, `deleted`, `business_id`) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{franchiseeName}, #{franchiseeMobile}, #{idCardNo}, #{bankName}, #{bankProvince}, #{bankCity}, #{bankCardNo}, COALESCE(#{creator}, ''), COALESCE(#{createTime}, NOW()), COALESCE(#{updater}, ''), COALESCE(#{updateTime}, NOW()), b'0', COALESCE(#{businessId}, 0)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `franchisee_name` = VALUES(`franchisee_name`), `franchisee_mobile` = VALUES(`franchisee_mobile`), `id_card_no` = VALUES(`id_card_no`), `bank_name` = VALUES(`bank_name`), `bank_province` = VALUES(`bank_province`), `bank_city` = VALUES(`bank_city`), `bank_card_no` = VALUES(`bank_card_no`), `updater` = VALUES(`updater`), `update_time` = VALUES(`update_time`), `deleted` = b'0', `business_id` = VALUES(`business_id`)
